sources.title_original: Plaintiff busted trying to use AI prompt injection to win court case, hides text instruction in filing — demands AI model reviewing the text should side with him, rumbled because of strange white spaces in text
sources.summary: A self-represented plaintiff in a Connecticut court added a hidden AI prompt injection attack in their filing in a failed attempt to influence a decision. The court bars them from submitting documents electronically and instead must print them and hand to the clerk of court.
sources.summary_zh: 康涅狄格州法院的一名自辩原告在其提交的文件中添加了隐藏的人工智能提示注入攻击，但未能影响判决。法院禁止他们以电子方式提交文件，而必须打印这些文件并交给法院书记员。

sources.summary: The Samsung Odyssey G80HS is a 32-inch IPS panel with 6K 6144x3456 resolution at 165 Hz plus 3072x1728 pixels at 330 Hz. It packs HDR wide-gamut color, Adaptive-Sync, and plenty of features into its slim chassis.
